"""Run required repository gates on one recorded, unchanged source tree."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

repo = Path('/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex')
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
files = subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard'],
    cwd=repo, text=True).splitlines()
files = [p for p in files if p.endswith(('.rs', '.html')) or Path(p).name in
         ['Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml']]
source = {
    'commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=repo, text=True).strip(),
    'files': {p: hashlib.sha256((repo / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files},
}
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', 'HEAD', '--', 'crates'], cwd=repo)
(root / 'source.json').write_text(json.dumps(source))
commands = [
    ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--', '--check'],
    ['cargo', 'check', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'build', '-p', 'logex-node', '--release', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'logex-query', '--release', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'logex-server', '--test', 'consistency', '--release', '--locked'],
]
with (root / 'results.jsonl').open('w') as stream:
    for index, command in enumerate(commands):
        assert all(hashlib.sha256((repo / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
                   for p, digest in source['files'].items())
        log = root / f'gate-{index}.log'
        started = time.monotonic()
        with log.open('w') as logs:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, stdout=logs, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        record = {'gate': index, 'command': command, 'exit': result.returncode,
                  'seconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 2), 'log': str(log)}
        stream.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
        stream.flush()
        print(record, flush=True)
        if result.returncode:
            raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
